title: The Marginalia
body: A water-stained page, bound into a book that has no business holding it — dense annotations in a hand that cites a library no map admits exists, where every rule ever written is shelved and still being written.

choices.label: Transcribe the marginal note in full
choices.resultText: You copy the citation and its impossible index. Somewhere, a door in a wall of books has been noticed noticing you.

choices.label: Note it and move on
choices.resultText: Some threads you pick up later, or not at all.

title: The Library That Has No Door
body: The annotations lead here: a hill that hums with dry paper, and a seam in the rock that is not a cave but a spine. The Infinite Athenaeum keeps its own entrance, and it is reading you back.

choices.label: Chart the way in
choices.resultText: You find the reading-angle where the seam becomes a threshold. The way in is charted.

choices.label: Not yet — turn back
choices.resultText: The way will keep. It has kept this long.

title: The Reading Paradox
body: The stacks go on past sight, and every book contradicts the last with equal authority. A page in the air asks the only question that matters: which of these is true?

choices.label: Resolve the paradox on its own terms
choices.resultText: You read the contradiction as a proof, not an error — the Arcanist's trick. The stacks fold into a single true aisle and let you pass.

choices.label: Brute-force the catalogue by exhaustion
choices.resultText: You read until your eyes bleed and your certainty breaks, and force a path by sheer refusal to stop. It works. It costs.

choices.label: Withdraw and gather strength
choices.resultText: It has waited. It can wait for you.

title: The Axiom Stone
body: At the library's still centre, the Axiom Stone rests on an empty lectern — a rule made solid, the grammar every spell obeys without knowing. One of the six.

choices.label: Take the Axiom Stone
choices.resultText: The Stone weighs nothing and settles everything; nearby, contradictions quietly resolve. One fragment of the Seal, recovered. Four remain.

choices.label: Leave it — the world is not ready
choices.resultText: You close the way behind you, and the fragment keeps its long patience.

title: The Stopped Watch
body: A traveller's watch, found in the frost, its hands locked at a minute that is not on any dial. Held to the ear it does not tick — it repeats, the same held breath of a second, over and over.

choices.label: Study the watch's frozen minute
choices.resultText: You learn to hear the repeating second and where it points — a place where the hours have pooled and stopped. The rumour takes root.

choices.label: Note it and move on
choices.resultText: Some threads you pick up later, or not at all.

title: Where the Hours Pool
body: Snow falls here and does not land. A moment ago is also now; a step forward is a step you have already taken. The Shattered Clock lies ahead, where time broke and never healed.

choices.label: Chart the way in
choices.resultText: You find the current in the stillness — the one direction that is still 'later.' The way is charted.

choices.label: Not yet — turn back
choices.resultText: The way will keep. It has kept this long.

title: The Recurring Minute
body: You enter a minute that will not end. The same wind, the same falling snow, the same three heartbeats, looping — and each loop, a little more of you forgets it has happened before.

choices.label: Step sideways out of the loop
choices.resultText: A Chronomancer knows a minute has a seam. You find it and step through, arriving on the far side of the recurrence unspent.

choices.label: Outlast the loop by counting it down
choices.resultText: You mark each turn of the minute in blood on your palm until the count means more than the loop, and break out — older than you were three heartbeats ago.

choices.label: Withdraw and gather strength
choices.resultText: It has waited. It can wait for you.

title: Moment Eternal
body: At the clock's dead centre hangs Moment Eternal — a single instant that never passes, lightning held mid-fork, a tear held mid-fall. One of the six.

choices.label: Take Moment Eternal
choices.resultText: The instant folds into your keeping; for a breath, everything around you is briefly, perfectly still. One fragment of the Seal, recovered. Three remain.

choices.label: Leave it — the world is not ready
choices.resultText: You close the way behind you, and the fragment keeps its long patience.

title: The Too-Happy Road
body: Every traveller on this road is smiling. Every one. They speak warmly of a city ahead where no one wants for anything, and none of them can tell you its name, and none of them will stop smiling while they fail to.

choices.label: Break a stranger's smile with a hard question
choices.resultText: For one instant the smile slips and something frightened looks out — then the glamour closes over it again. But you have the city's shape now, and the thread that stitches it.

choices.label: Note it and move on
choices.resultText: Some threads you pick up later, or not at all.

title: The City That Sings
body: The Charmed City rises without walls, because it needs none — the enchantment is the wall. A song with no source keeps every citizen content and every gate open, and closing on you like warm water.

choices.label: Chart the way in
choices.resultText: You learn to hum against the song, off by a half-step, enough to keep your own name. The way in is charted.

choices.label: Not yet — turn back
choices.resultText: The way will keep. It has kept this long.

title: The Glamour's Weave
body: The song offers you everything you have ever wanted, phrased as a memory you didn't know you had. To take it is to stay, smiling, forever. The Binding Thread runs through the heart of the weave.

choices.label: Turn the glamour back on itself
choices.resultText: An Enchanter knows a charm is a sentence, and every sentence can be reparsed. You answer the song in its own grammar and it lets you through, deferential.

choices.label: Refuse the song until it frays
choices.resultText: You hold your own name against the offer and do not let go, though holding it tears something. The weave frays enough to slip through.

choices.label: Withdraw and gather strength
choices.resultText: It has waited. It can wait for you.

title: The Binding Thread
body: At the city's silent core, the Binding Thread waits — the Enchanter's fragment, and the connective piece: the strand that lets the other five be held together. Recover it, and every fragment to come will settle easier. One of the six.

choices.label: Take the Binding Thread
choices.resultText: The Thread coils into your keeping, and the fragments you do not yet hold feel, somehow, already nearer. One fragment of the Seal, recovered — and the others made easier.

choices.label: Leave it — the world is not ready
choices.resultText: You close the way behind you, and the fragment keeps its long patience.

title: The Ticking Under the Hill
body: The ground here keeps time. Put a hand to the rock and you feel it: a vast, patient mechanism turning somewhere below, tended by no one, stopping for nothing, older than the kingdom that forgot it.

choices.label: Chart the rhythm of the buried works
choices.resultText: You map the engine's beat and where its access-shaft must lie. The rumour of the Eternal Engine takes hold.

choices.label: Note it and move on
choices.resultText: Some threads you pick up later, or not at all.

title: The Engine That Wakes
body: A door of gears, each the size of a house, grinds in the hillside — the mouth of the Eternal Engine, a machine that has run since before the schools had names and will run after. It does not idle for visitors.

choices.label: Chart the way in
choices.resultText: You time the gap between the great gears' teeth. The way in is charted — for the brave and the quick.

choices.label: Not yet — turn back
choices.resultText: The way will keep. It has kept this long.

title: The Governor's Fault
body: Inside, the Engine races toward a fault it will not survive — or it would, if it could die. A governor spins red-hot, demanding correction from anyone who would pass its housing to reach the Core.

choices.label: Recalibrate the governor
choices.resultText: A Tinker reads a machine the way others read a face. You ease the governor back to true, and the Engine grants passage to a hand that mends rather than takes.

choices.label: Wedge the works and squeeze past
choices.resultText: You jam a spar into the gearing and slip through the stalled housing before it screams and shakes itself free. It bites you on the way.

choices.label: Withdraw and gather strength
choices.resultText: It has waited. It can wait for you.

title: The Schema Core
body: At the Engine's heart the Schema Core turns — the pattern the machine is forever building toward, the Tinker's fragment, order made to run itself. One of the six.

choices.label: Take the Schema Core
choices.resultText: You lift the Core from its spindle and the Engine, for the first time in an age, slows — content. One fragment of the Seal, recovered. Two remain.

choices.label: Leave it — the world is not ready
choices.resultText: You close the way behind you, and the fragment keeps its long patience.

title: The Grave That Answers
body: You speak the small rite for the unburied dead, as any decent traveller might — and this time the grave answers back. A single word, in a voice like cold mud settling: 'Hollow.' It knows you can hear it.

choices.label: Ask the grave what it means
choices.resultText: The dead here are not silent, and they are not free. They speak of the Hollow — a door the living do not find by walking. Now you know to look.

choices.label: Note it and move on
choices.resultText: Some threads you pick up later, or not at all.

title: The Door in the Barrow
body: No path leads to the Hollow; you reach it the way the dead do. In a barrow that breathes cold, the threshold waits — the Necromancer's realm, where the fragment sleeps among things that used to have names.

choices.label: Chart the way in
choices.resultText: You find the crossing-rite the barrow will accept. The way down is charted — though the way back is never promised.

choices.label: Not yet — turn back
choices.resultText: The way will keep. It has kept this long.

title: The Toll of the Dead
body: The Hollow does not give. Its wardens are the ancient dead, and they demand proof that you understand what it is to command them — not merely the power, but the debt. The realm drinks the warmth from the living with every breath.

choices.label: Answer the dead as their keeper
choices.resultText: A Necromancer speaks to the dead as kin and custodian, not master. The wardens weigh your answer, find the debt acknowledged, and let you pass unbled.

choices.label: Endure the Hollow's toll and press on
choices.resultText: The dead take their toll in living warmth, and you pay it, step by frozen step, until you stand where you meant to. It nearly takes everything.

choices.label: Withdraw and gather strength
choices.resultText: It has waited. It can wait for you.

title: The Deathless Covenant
body: At the Hollow's still heart lies the Deathless Covenant — the Necromancer's fragment, the promise that binds the dead to order rather than hunger. One of the six.

choices.label: Take the Deathless Covenant
choices.resultText: The Covenant settles into your keeping, cold and certain, and the wardens bow their ruined heads. One fragment of the Seal, recovered. One remains.

choices.label: Leave it — the world is not ready
choices.resultText: You close the way behind you, and the fragment keeps its long patience.
